title: Apple’s new Mac Mini has fresh M6 and M5 Pro chip offerings — and higher prices
summary: Apple is announcing a new generation of the Mac Mini , once again offering two models: one with a new M6 chip and a higher-end model with the M5 Pro found in this year’s MacBook Pro.
